messages:
Sasha Kim: Quick sync  we need a tiny customer-facing activation brief (one-page) that covers prefill/prefetch, three batching presets, streaming safety-net, and a short renewal-signal to watch. Goal: AE can paste into onboarding email.
Leo Park: Keep customer copy super short. 1-sentence "what we do", 3-checklist bullets, one fallback line. Engineers get a short appendix.
Omar Haddad: I can draft ENG appendix: small config snippet, curl toggle for fallback, and two PromQL queries.
Grace Lin: Renewal signal idea: if week-2 active sessions < 60% of expected baseline -> mark as "engage" and schedule health call. Also send a 1-question micro-survey.
Sasha Kim: Customer opener draft: "Well prime a representative set of your prompts, keep a small warm pool for core flows, and temporarily switch to polling if streaming is unstable. Well monitor key metrics and reach out if we see issues."
Leo Park: Customer checklist (copyable):
- Confirm model + version pinned in your config
- Share 3 golden examples we should prime
- Expect active monitoring for first 72 hours
If anything looks odd, reply with example prompts.
Omar Haddad: ENG presets (pasteable):
1) latency-first: `batch_window_ms=50`, `max_batch_tokens=512`
2) balanced: `batch_window_ms=150`, `max_batch_tokens=2048`
3) cost-saver: `batch_window_ms=300`, `max_batch_tokens=4096`
Also recommend `prefill_mode=staggered` and `warm_pool_size=4` for small customers.
Sasha Kim: Add a tiny prefill config snippet for customers (non-prod first):
```
# PREFILL (non-prod before prod)
prefill_enabled: true
prefill_sample_size: 150
prefill_mode: staggered  # immediate | staggered | steady
warm_pool_size: 4
warm_pool_ttl_hours: 72
```
Grace Lin: Observability (customer-friendly labels + thresholds): `prefill_success_rate >= 90%`, `cache_hit_rate >= 60%`, `p95_ttf_ms < 800`, `stream_disconnects_per_10k < 10`. If breached, run escalation.
Leo Park: Short escalation playbook (internal + CS): 1) CS collect 3 failing prompts + repro in non-prod. 2) ENG validate cache keys & model pin. 3) ENG oncall: attach traces, enable polling fallback, and notify CS.
Omar Haddad: Small curl to toggle fallback (ENG internal):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/admin/fallback \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"mode":"polling","interval_ms":500}'
```
Omar Haddad: PromQL snippets for appendix: p95 time-to-first-token
```promql
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```
and stream disconnects per 10k:```promql
sum(rate(stream_disconnects_total[5m])) * 10000
```
Sasha Kim: Customer-facing fallback UX line: "Were temporarily using a polling mode to keep responses stable while we investigate streaming interruptions." Add to handbook.
Grace Lin: Renewal micro-survey (1 q): "Have you seen any drop in usage or change in perceived quality since go-live? (Yes/No)" If Yes -> schedule health call.
Leo Park: Action items: @Omar finalize ENG appendix by Thursday, @Grace craft the 1-line micro-survey and AE email, Ill assemble the one-pager and link the runbook.
runbook-bot: New runbook created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cs/activation-brief-prefetch-batching-safety-net (access: customer-success, eng)
